mechanism_narrative: Persistent WORKPLACES deficit (t-0w: -30.9%) signals sustained remote work adoption. This reduces commuter foot traffic and incidental retail visits, driving RETAIL_REC further negative over the next four weeks as the baseline of office-dependent shopping erodes.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES declined from -25.7% to -30.9% over three weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days exceeds mean over last 28 days, or WORKPLACES recovers above -20% within two weeks.

regime_hint: favorable weather or seasonal outdoor activity peak
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases week-on-week in 3 of 4 weeks ahead, or PARKS falls below +10% and RETAIL_REC does not stabilize.

regime_hint: tightening mobility restrictions or transit service disruption
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days is higher than last 28 days, or either TRANSIT or WORKPLACES recovers above threshold within one week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over next 28 days relative to last 28 days, or GROCERY_PHARM rebounds above +5% within one week.

regime_hint: transit service restriction or capacity constraint regime
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases in week t+1, or TRANSIT recovers above -15% within one week.
